entry.title: Dea/L0 2.1.0: a public C runtime interface

link.title: Dea/L0 2.1.0: a public C runtime interface

entry.summary: I have released Dea/L0 2.1.0, a focused update to the self-hosted foundation of the Dea systems programming language. This release gives C code a supported interface to the runtime, fixes several runtime correctness issues, and reorganizes both compiler stages into smaller modules.
